question: What remedy is required when there is a total absence of the ritual elements over many days?
premises: A total absence of ritual elements may occur.
This absence may persist for many days.
A peace fire offering is required as remedy.
inference: Therefore, in total absence, even over many days, one should conduct a peace fire offering.
plain_english: In the case of total absence, even over many days, one should perform a peace fire offering.
